Country Music

Playing Country & Western Line Dance 

🤠 Section 1: The Legends & Sing-Alongs (Originals + New Classics)

The songs everyone knows the words to, from the 60s to the 80s.

  1. 40 Hour Week (For a Livin’) – Alabama

  2. Feels So Right – Alabama

  3. Mountain Music – Alabama (ADD)

  4. Dixieland Delight – Alabama (ADD)

  5. Achy Breaky Heart – Billy Ray Cyrus

  6. All My Rowdy Friends (Are Coming Over Tonight) – Hank Williams Jr.

  7. Family Tradition – Hank Williams Jr. (ADD)

  8. Crazy – Patsy Cline

  9. Walking After Midnight – Patsy Cline

  10. Good Hearted Woman – Willie Nelson

  11. Mamas Don’t Let Your Babies Grow Up To Be Cowboys – Willie Nelson

  12. Mendocino County Line – Willie Nelson

  13. On The Road Again – Willie Nelson

  14. Happy Trails – Roy Rogers

  15. Highway Patrol – Junior Brown

  16. Rhinestone Cowboy – Glen Campbell

  17. Ring Of Fire – Johnny Cash

  18. Folsom Prison Blues – Johnny Cash (ADD)

  19. The Gambler – Kenny Rogers

  20. Through The Years – Kenny Rogers

  21. Take Me Home, Country Roads – John Denver

  22. Take This Job And Shove It – Johnny Paycheck

  23. Waltz Across Texas – Ernest Tubb

  24. Elvira – Oak Ridge Boys

  25. Swingin’ – John Anderson

  26. The Devil Went Down To Georgia – Charlie Daniels Band

  27. Take It Easy – Eagles

  28. Love Will Keep Us Alive – Eagles

  29. Copperhead Road – Steve Earle (ADD)

💃 Section 2: The 90s Prime Time (Line Dance & High Energy)

The core of any country dance party.

  1. Boot Scootin’ Boogie – Brooks & Dunn

  2. My Maria – Brooks & Dunn

  3. Rock My World (Little Country Girl) – Brooks & Dunn

  4. Play Something Country – Brooks & Dunn

  5. Neon Moon – Brooks & Dunn (ADD)

  6. Chattahoochee – Alan Jackson

  7. Chasin’ That Neon Rainbow – Alan Jackson

  8. Don’t Rock The Jukebox – Alan Jackson

  9. It’s Five O’Clock Somewhere – Alan Jackson (ADD)

  10. Watermelon Crawl – Tracy Byrd

  11. Baby Likes To Rock It – The Tractors

  12. Down At The Twist And Shout – Mary Chapin Carpenter

  13. Fast As You Can – Dwight Yoakam

  14. Guuitars, Cadillacs – Dwight Yoakam (ADD)

  15. I Like It, I Love It – Tim McGraw

  16. I Like My Women On The Trashy Side – Sawyer Brown

  17. If Bubba Can Dance (I Can Too) – Shenandoah

  18. Third Rock From The Sun – Joe Diffie

  19. John Deere Green – Joe Diffie (ADD)

  20. Sold (The Grundy County Auction Incident) – John Michael Montgomery (ADD)

  21. Life Is A Highway – Rascal Flatts

  22. Fast Cars and Freedom – Rascal Flatts

  23. Mayberry – Rascal Flatts

  24. Stand – Rascal Flatts

  25. Ellsworth – Rascal Flatts

  26. Head Over Heels – Rascal Flatts

  27. The Day Before You – Rascal Flatts

  28. Good Lovin’ – The Rascals

  29. Man! I Feel Like A Woman! – Shania Twain (ADD)

  30. Any Man of Mine – Shania Twain (ADD)

  31. Whose Bed Have Your Boots Been Under? – Shania Twain (ADD)

🔥 Section 3: Modern Party & “Bro-Country” Anthems

High energy for the younger crowd and club vibe.

  1. Save A Horse (Ride A Cowboy) – Big & Rich

  2. Redneck Woman – Gretchen Wilson

  3. We Came Here To Party – Gretchen Wilson

  4. Country Girl (Shake It For Me) – Luke Bryan

  5. Drunk On You – Luke Bryan

  6. Crash My Party – Luke Bryan

  7. I Don’t Want This Night To End – Luke Bryan

  8. Someone Else Calling You Baby – Luke Bryan

  9. Love In A College Town – Luke Bryan

  10. Drink In My Hand – Eric Church

  11. Mud On The Tires – Brad Paisley

  12. This Is Country Music – Brad Paisley

  13. Got My Country On – Chris Cagle

  14. Let There Be Cowgirls – Chris Cagle

  15. Chicks Dig It – Chris Cagle

  16. Summertime – Kenny Chesney

  17. Beer In Mexico – Kenny Chesney

  18. When The Sun Goes Down – Kenny Chesney & Uncle Kracker

  19. Somewhere With You – Kenny Chesney

  20. Ladies Love Country Boys – Trace Adkins

  21. Swing – Trace Adkins

  22. Honky Tonk Badonkadonk – Trace Adkins (ADD)

  23. Honey Bee – Blake Shelton

  24. Who Are You When I’m Not Looking – Blake Shelton

  25. God’s Country – Blake Shelton (ADD)

  26. My Kinda Party – Jason Aldean

  27. Dirt Road Anthem – Jason Aldean

  28. She’s Country – Jason Aldean (ADD)

  29. Why Don’t We Just Dance – Josh Turner

  30. Red Solo Cup – Toby Keith

  31. How Do You Like Me Now?! – Toby Keith

  32. Beer For My Horses – Toby Keith (ADD)

  33. That’s My Story – Collin Raye

  34. One Boy, One Girl – Collin Raye

  35. Where The Blacktop Ends – Keith Urban

  36. Put You In A Song – Keith Urban

  37. Somebody Like You – Keith Urban (ADD)

  38. Wagon Wheel – Darius Rucker (ADD)

  39. Chicken Fried – Zac Brown Band (ADD)

⚡ Section 4: 2024–2026 Radio & Club Hits (The New Additions)

The absolute latest songs keeping country at #1.

  1. A Bar Song (Tipsy) – Shaboozey

  2. I Had Some Help – Post Malone ft. Morgan Wallen

  3. TEXAS HOLD ‘EM – Beyoncé

  4. Austin (Boots Stop Workin’) – Dasha

  5. Miles On It – Marshmello & Kane Brown

  6. Last Night – Morgan Wallen

  7. Whiskey On You – Nate Smith

  8. Fast Car – Luke Combs

💍 Section 5: The Ballads & Slow Dances

For the couples and the closing of the night.

  1. Amazed – Lonestar

  2. I Cross My Heart – George Strait

  3. Check Yes or No – George Strait (ADD)

  4. I Swear – John Michael Montgomery

  5. I Love The Way You Love Me – John Michael Montgomery

  6. It’s Your Love – Tim McGraw & Faith Hill

  7. I Need You – Tim McGraw & Faith Hill

  8. One Of Those Nights – Tim McGraw

  9. Your Man – Josh Turner

  10. Bless The Broken Road – Rascal Flatts

  11. What Hurts The Most – Rascal Flatts

  12. Love You Out Loud – Rascal Flatts

  13. Forever and Ever, Amen – Randy Travis (ADD)

  14. Your Still The One – Shania Twain

  15. From This Moment On – Shania Twain

  16. Love Story – Taylor Swift

  17. You Belong With Me – Taylor Swift

  18. Back To December – Taylor Swift

  19. Remember When – Alan Jackson

  20. Friends In Low Places – Garth Brooks

  21. Shameless – Garth Brooks

  22. Rodeo – Garth Brooks

  23. If Tomorrow Never Comes – Garth Brooks

  24. It’s Your Song – Garth Brooks

  25. To Make You Feel My Love – Garth Brooks

  26. Keeper Of The Stars – Tracy Byrd

  27. Look At Us – Vince Gill

  28. Tennessee Whiskey – Chris Stapleton
